title: Add auth plugin package with route scaffolding and service registration
body:
Implements foundational structure for `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to enable authentication integration in ObjectStack applications. Core authentication logic deferred to future implementation with `@planned` annotations.

## Package Structure

- **AuthPlugin** - Implements full plugin lifecycle (init/start/destroy) and registers HTTP routes
- **AuthManager** - Stub class with method signatures for login/register/logout/session operations
- **Route Registration** - Scaffolds `/api/v1/auth/*` endpoints via IHttpServer interface
- **Service Integration** - Registers `auth` service in ObjectKernel for dependency injection

## Configuration

Uses existing `AuthConfig` schema from `@objectstack/spec/system`:

```typescript
new AuthPlugin({
  secret: process.env.AUTH_SECRET,
  baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000',
  providers: [{ id: 'google', clientId: '...', clientSecret: '...' }],
  plugins: { organization: true, twoFactor: true },
  basePath: '/api/v1/auth',
})
```

## Dependencies

- better-auth listed as optional peer dependency
- Runtime deps: `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/spec`
- Test coverage: 11/11 tests passing

## API Routes

```
POST   /api/v1/auth/login
POST   /api/v1/auth/register
POST   /api/v1/auth/logout
GET    /api/v1/auth/session
```

Current implementation throws "not yet implemented" errors - actual authentication logic to be added when better-auth integration is completed.

## Documentation

Updated official documentation to reflect the new plugin:

- **Package Reference** (`content/docs/concepts/packages.mdx`) - Added plugin-auth to Plugin Packages section, updated package count from 15 to 16
- **Service Registry** (`content/docs/concepts/core/services.mdx`) - Added `auth` service to Standard Services table with `plugin-auth` as provider
- **Kernel Services Checklist** (`content/docs/guides/kernel-services.mdx`) - Updated auth service status from "Plugin Required" to "In Development"
